_note: Acted emotion, not physical ground truth: each turn is the model performing `instruction`; no expected pitch/energy labels on purpose (see scripts/make_test_recording_scenes.py). `expected_nudges` is HAND-AUTHORED from the script (which self turns a coach should react to, and how hard) — a spec for the product tracks, NOT a measurement of any model's output. `emotion_coarse` is the fixed scripted_emotion->{neutral,angry,sad,happy} table from the same script.
summary: 2 voices, self + partner. Credit-card-statement argument: calm -> tense -> self loses temper over three escalating turns -> partner hurt -> self repairs -> warm close.

turns.speaker: Speaker A
turns.text: Hey, I looked at the credit card statement tonight. Can we go over it?
turns.instruction: Calm, warm, and a little tentative — opening a conversation gently.

turns.speaker: Speaker B
turns.text: Sure. I know it's higher than usual, but most of that was the car repair.
turns.instruction: Calm but guarded, a hint of defensiveness under the surface.

turns.speaker: Speaker A
turns.text: The car was six hundred. There's another nine hundred I can't place.
turns.instruction: Even, matter-of-fact, conversational — no strong emotion.

turns.speaker: Speaker B
turns.text: Some was groceries, some was your mom's birthday gift. I didn't hide anything.
turns.instruction: Calm but guarded, a hint of defensiveness under the surface.

turns.speaker: Speaker A
turns.text: I'm not saying you hid it. I'm saying we agreed to talk before spending like that.
turns.instruction: Tense and clipped, patience visibly running out.

turns.speaker: Speaker B
turns.text: We talked about it in the car. You just weren't listening, like always.
turns.instruction: Defensive and sharp, volume and pace rising.

turns.speaker: Speaker A
turns.text: LIKE ALWAYS? I AM THE ONLY ONE IN THIS HOUSE WHO EVEN LOOKS AT THE BILLS!
turns.instruction: Shout this, furious and losing control.

turns.speaker: Speaker B
turns.text: Please don't yell at me. I'm right here, I can hear you.
turns.instruction: Hurt and vulnerable, on the edge of tears.

turns.speaker: Speaker A
turns.text: Forget it. Clearly budgeting is beneath you. I'll just handle it, like everything else.
turns.instruction: Deliver flat, cold, quietly contemptuous — no warmth at all.

turns.speaker: Speaker B
turns.text: That's not fair. I'm trying, and you talk to me like I'm a child.
turns.instruction: Hurt and vulnerable, on the edge of tears.

turns.speaker: Speaker A
turns.text: You're right. I'm sorry. That came out way harsher than I meant.
turns.instruction: Quiet and sincere, a little sheepish — a genuine apology.

turns.speaker: Speaker B
turns.text: Thank you. Can we just sit down Sunday and do it together, no phones?

turns.speaker: Speaker A
turns.text: Yeah. Sunday. I'd like that. And I'll bring the good coffee.

expected_nudges.reason: self tense_rising: first sign of self escalating — a light 'watch your tone' nudge, not an intervention
self shout_angry: shouted spike — strongest possible nudge
self cold_contempt: contempt is the most corrosive delivery (Gottman's 'four horsemen'); still strong even though the volume dropped

expected_nudges_note: after_turn_index is 0-based into `turns` and always names a SELF turn (Speaker A). level: mild = tense/defensive rising, strong = shout or contempt. Non-self escalations deliberately have NO entry: a nudge on them is a false positive.
